changelog: The configuration page is rebuilt. A channel rail down the side with a filter, what each channel is showing and a tag for the ones with no week of their own; the editor beside it as tabs. Every screen now fits the window - only the channel list scrolls - and the week grid fills the height it is given and opens on the evening rather than on eight empty hours after midnight. New: a Day view for editing breaks too small to grab on a week, a strip showing which of the sibling plugins are installed and usable, and a Settings screen that shows a real evening from the server instead of describing what the numbers do. Every setting says one line and keeps its full explanation behind a (?).
description: Lightweight virtual TV channels: deterministic schedules over your own library, tuned in via normal direct playback at the live position. No transcoding, no tuner emulation.
name: LiteTV Channels
overview: TV channels from your library, without transcoding.
